notes.title: Reading through reviews and taking notes. Trying to get help with an IK bug.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, today I am taking notes from all of the Steam reviews and using those to make a sort of list of improvements while I solve this IK issue.

I am currently trying to figure out why all of my IK solvers are bugged out in builds. To sum up the issue all the limbs of characters in game builds are sort of stretched looking.
In-editor all is fine.

My last resort is to just duplicate my main project files and try a fresh project. In the mean time I am just taking notes and trying to get some outside help with this issue as it is still only me working on this game.

I am not happy with the currently released product. I know I can do much better and I am confident this update will reflect everything I have learned since the last then. I will spend as much time as I can trying to make this what I wanted it to be.

I will also be stepping up the Patreon so I can show everyone my plan for this game's future after releasing this major "Playability" update that fixes the crappy dialogue system and major bugs in addition to new content and ways to play.


Thanks for bearing with me.

notes.title: How to play the VR version / Installing the Android apk
notes.notes:
You'll find the roomscale VR version in your install directory in a folder called "Desire Den VR 1.05d1" currently all roomscale VR headsets are supported.

The android apk is in a folder called "Desire Villa Demo Android APK" 

To install the android demo you will need to activate developer mode on your device which is usually going to your system information in settings and tapping your build number until you see "You are now a developer!"

After that you will want to go to your security settings and check "Allow unknown sources" 

You should now be able to install the Desire Villa demo for android! 

Enjoy!

notes.title: A Note For VR Players
notes.notes:
A player in the Steam discussions asked why some of the wolves/dogs upstairs are see through.

I realized there is definitely no context if you are exclusively a VR player since there is no dialogue to explain their appearance.

The wolves/dogs you see that are see through are actually virtual dogs.

This will be better illustrated soon. I am adding a sort of hovering puck above each that will project some cool effects downward giving the illusion of a hologram. (Fun Fact: This was the same tech they used to bring Tupac back at Coachella)

notes.title: How to access the VR version
notes.notes:
The VR version is included as a separate .zip located in the main game's install folder. Simply extract this folder and run the .exe to play in VR with full roomscale locomotion. 

You may need to manually select the graphical fidelity from the launcher's settings depending on your system's capabilities.
